read_sources: canonical WEB Zephaniah coordinates and text
not_read: state or completion artifacts for Zeph

non_authority_statement: Candidate literary and structural evidence only. Every boundary is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, ethics, identity, fulfillment, covenant system, preferred witness, preferred reading, preferred translation, source tradition, graph, retrieval, reviewed-gold, or promotion authority.
routing_principle: Prefer larger coherent summons, oracle cycles, woe movements, and song closures. Speaker, addressee, day language, imperatives, place-name chains, genre shifts, and refrains are evidence only.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: superscription and expanding day-of-Yahweh judgment movement
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Sweeping opening, Jerusalem indictment, sacrifice summons, city search, and battle poem intensify toward a climax.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: seek summons and compass-like nations-oracle circuit
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Imperative opening and west-east-south-north sequence form one movement.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: Jerusalem woe, nations assembly, purification, and remnant
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: City indictment turns through judicial speech toward transformed peoples and remnant.
Song imperatives open a sustained reversal and ingathering conclusion.

global_hot_zones.issue: Sweep formula may stand alone or remain with superscription.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep as programmatic opening; preserve 1:1-only alternative.

global_hot_zones.issue: Sacrifice imagery and identities invite adjudication.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep tableau together; decide no identity, date, or ritual meaning.

global_hot_zones.issue: Place names, lament, lamp-search, and wine image permit smaller sayings.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain one Jerusalem-search movement; preserve alternatives.

global_hot_zones.issue: Distinct addressees support separate oracles while geography supports one cycle.
global_hot_zones.handling: Prefer larger nations cycle; infer no ethnic theology, date, or fulfillment.

global_hot_zones.issue: Judgment turns sharply toward purified speech and remnant.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep reversal together; preserve seam at 3:9.

global_hot_zones.issue: Song, speech, reversal, and ingathering permit internal strophes.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain complete closure; defer speaker and fulfillment.

units.title: Superscription and sweeping judgment
units.deciding_marker: Title opens the book and repeated sweep-away diction states the program before focus narrows to Judah.
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating 1:1 or attaching 1:2-3 to Judah indictment.
units.risk: genealogy, dating, creation imagery, rhetoric, and scope

units.title: Judah and Jerusalem cult indictment
units.literary_form: focused indictment with catalogue of practices
units.deciding_marker: Focus narrows explicitly to Judah and Jerusalem; catalogue closes before hush command.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting by practice or merging into universal sweep.
units.risk: cult terms, named deities, ethics, and history

units.title: Day summons and prepared sacrifice
units.literary_form: hush summons, sacrifice tableau, and visitation sayings
units.deciding_marker: Hush and near-day announcement introduce sacrifice tableau and repeated visitation.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating summons from guest and official visitation.
units.risk: sacrifice, identities, clothing, threshold practice, violence, and date

units.title: Merchants and lamp-search of Jerusalem
units.literary_form: city soundscape, commercial lament, and search oracle
units.deciding_marker: In-that-day cries move through city locations and merchant collapse into lamp-search and property reversal.
units.rejected_alternative: Dividing city cries, lament, search, and settled-wine saying.
units.risk: toponyms, class, divine action, metaphor, and fulfillment

units.title: Near day and battle-darkness poem
units.deciding_marker: Near-day language opens a day-is catalogue, trumpet imagery, distress, and no-deliverance closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Atomizing catalogue or detaching silver-and-gold closure.
units.risk: day theology, battle imagery, violence, universality, and fulfillment

units.title: Gather and seek summons
units.deciding_marker: Gather and seek imperatives, before clauses, and possibility formula close before nations cycle.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating gathering from triple seek appeal or absorbing into Philistia.
units.risk: addressee, Hebrew metaphor, humility, possibility, and deliverance

units.title: Nations taunts and compass oracle cycle
units.literary_form: multi-address nations-oracle sequence ending in city taunt
units.deciding_marker: For opens western cities; woe and therefore formulas move through Moab-Ammon, Cush, and Assyria/Nineveh to final taunt.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting directional cycle by nation or detaching closing taunt.
units.risk: ethnic identity, land, remnant, geography, violence, and fulfillment

units.title: Woe to the rebellious city
units.literary_form: city woe, leadership indictment, contrast, and failed-warning speech
units.deciding_marker: Woe opens accusation, catalogs leaders, contrasts righteous presence, and closes with failed correction.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting leadership catalogue from contrast and first-person reflection.
units.risk: city identity, offices, law, justice, speech, and history

units.title: Nations purification and humble remnant
units.literary_form: wait summons, judicial assembly, reversal, and remnant portrait
units.deciding_marker: Therefore wait opens nations assembly; purified speech, removal of pride, and remnant complete reversal.
units.rejected_alternative: Cutting at 3:9 into unrelated judgment and salvation units.
units.risk: speaker, nations, language purification, worship, diaspora, remnant, and fulfillment

units.title: Zion song and restoration closure
units.literary_form: communal song summons, reassurance, and restoration oracle
units.deciding_marker: Sing, shout, rejoice, and exult launch sustained reversal through gathering, renown, return, and says-Yahweh closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating song at 3:17, gathering at 3:18, or promises at 3:19.
units.risk: Zion identity, divine emotion, syntax, disability language, land, return, and fulfillment
